answer.reason: The marked verses tell of Hadad's rise as an adversary, his flight to Egypt as a child, and his favour with Pharaoh.

clauses.english: was stirred up by the LORD as an adversary to Solomon
clauses.quote: the LORD stirred up an adversary unto Solomon, Hadad the Edomite

clauses.english: fled to Egypt as a little child
clauses.quote: to go into Egypt; Hadad being yet a little child.

clauses.english: found great favour with Pharaoh, who gave him his wife's sister in marriage
clauses.quote: Hadad found great favour in the sight of Pharaoh

doubts: 1KI 11:25 (reigned over Syria) seems to describe Rezon, so it was not used for a clause.
His request to Pharaoh in 1KI 11:21 to go back to his own country was left out as a minor detail.
